implement.name: Compose is the default
implement.summary: A Composable is the default UI unit for an Android or Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile surface; Views is an explicit choice

implement.name: Views as an explicit choice
implement.summary: A Views-based widget or Activity is rejected unless the PR states the justification (legacy migration, third-party View-only library, performance)

implement.name: Tokens come from Material 3
implement.summary: A hardcoded color, typography step, shape corner, elevation or state-layer value is refused; Material 3 tokens (`MaterialTheme.colorScheme`, `typography`, `shapes`, `elevation`) are the source

implement.name: Components come from Material 3
implement.summary: A custom Button, Card, AppBar, NavigationBar, ListItem, Dialog or Snackbar built without `androidx.compose.material3` is refused; reach for the matching component

implement.name: Dynamic color on Android 12+
implement.summary: Dynamic color (Material You) is the default on Android 12 and above; a static brand palette requires a stated justification

implement.name: Touch target ≥ 48dp
implement.summary: An interactive control smaller than 48dp × 48dp is refused; the Material 3 minimum is the threshold, not the recommendation

implement.name: Contrast ratio meets WCAG AA
implement.summary: Body text against its background must reach 4.5:1; large text (≥18sp regular or ≥14sp bold) 3:1; numbers, not aesthetic judgement

implement.name: contentDescription on icon-only controls
implement.summary: An `IconButton` or icon-only `Button` without a `contentDescription` is refused; the TalkBack label is part of the contract, not a finishing touch

implement.name: Material 3 audit
implement.summary: Measure an Android or Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile surface against these refusals, finding by finding

review.name: Compose default honoured
review.summary: A new Composable where a View-based widget would be the obvious shape is refused unless the justification is in the PR

review.name: Views choice justified
review.summary: A Views-based surface without a stated justification (legacy migration, View-only library, performance) is refused

review.name: Hardcoded UI values
review.summary: A color, typography step, shape, elevation or state-layer value not pulled from `MaterialTheme.*` is refused

review.name: Reinvented Material 3 component
review.summary: A Button, Card, AppBar, NavigationBar, ListItem, Dialog or Snackbar built from scratch instead of `material3.*` is refused

review.name: Dynamic color without justification
review.summary: A static brand palette on Android 12+ without a stated justification is refused

review.name: Touch target below 48dp
review.summary: An interactive control smaller than 48dp × 48dp is refused

review.name: Contrast ratio below WCAG AA
review.summary: A body-text or large-text pair below 4.5:1 or 3:1 respectively is refused

review.name: Icon-only control without contentDescription
review.summary: An `IconButton` without a TalkBack-readable label is refused

audit.name: Material 3 audit
audit.summary: Measure an Android or Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile surface against the seven refusals above, finding by finding
